description: This file defines a Flutter widget named SearchAndFilterBar that provides a search input field along with tag filtering options. It allows users to input search queries, clear the input, and select/deselect tags via filter chips to refine search results within a journal application.

classes.name: SearchAndFilterBar
classes.description: A stateless Flutter widget that displays a search bar with tag filtering options, allowing users to search through journal entries and filter them by tags.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs the widget tree for the search and filter interface, including the search input field and filter chips for tags.
